name: censof-tools
description: Censof internal Claude plugins — the GRP knowledge base connector and the tools built on it.

plugins.name: censof-mcp
plugins.description: Search the GRP knowledge base — 101k closed RFS tickets, Acumatica documentation, and the GRP manuals — and diagnose a support ticket end to end with the rfs-analyze skill.

plugins.name: grp-mcp
plugins.description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude — read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across all five of Acumatica's APIs. Connects straight to your own instance; credentials never leave your machine. Windows, macOS and Linux. Needs uv.

plugins.name: grp-mcp-mac
plugins.description: Superseded by grp-mcp, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this. Kept so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating; new installs should take grp-mcp. Install one or the other, never both.
